<question type="answerable">
Is there a way to stop people from seeing when I'm typing?
</question>

<expected_answer>
- Yes: turn off sending typing notifications
- Desktop/Web: gear icon, then Personal settings, then Account & privacy
- Under Privacy, toggle the settings that let recipients see when you're typing
</expected_answer>

<help_center_quotes>
- "you can configure Zulip to not send typing notifications" (https://zulip.com/help/typing-notifications, Disable sending typing notifications)
</help_center_quotes>

<answer>
Yes. You can configure Zulip so that others don't see when you're typing. On desktop or web, click the gear icon in the upper right corner of the web or desktop app. Select Personal settings. On the left, click Account & privacy. Under Privacy, toggle Let recipients see when I'm typing direct messages and Let recipients see when I'm typing messages in channels.
</answer>
